what: MTH descriptions on every MTH item tab: product-line words and a repeated road name off the front of MTH's whole-title descriptions; fragments rebuilt and run-on text cut, checked against mthtrains.com

C fragment descriptions / road names rebuilt from MTH's page; a cab number kept only if MTH lists it
D text run on after three spaces cut; MTH's title used only when MTH lists cab numbers and the cut text names others
F three rows checked by eye
